description:
PR #876 test-refactoring review requested by the user on 2026-11-20.

File: test/zaq/channels/delivery/executor_test.exs.
Destination: "successful delivery retains the report for both multiple groups and a single group".
Source: "fully confirmed delivery does not report that its messages were not sent".

Both execute Executor.execute(outgoing(:continue, 2, true), OperationBridge, connection()). Extend the destination's multiple-group report pattern with delivered_attachment_indices [0] and [1], and carry over the assertion and diagnostic message rejecting report[:delivery] == :not_sent. Retire only the redundant second test execution.

Acceptance: retain all multi-group and single-group assertions, uploaded attachments, failed attachments, unattempted steps, and step outcomes. Keep existing properties and failure/timeout/concurrency tests. Expected saving is roughly 15 lines; readability and complete coverage take precedence over a numeric target.
Validation: mix q and the focused delivery executor suite. Final validation remains owned by zaq-1lw.13.

Action reuse assessment: not applicable to production operations; this is test-only consolidation using existing public contracts and fixtures. No production API or behavior changes.
Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/code-quality.md, and docs/conventions.md before implementation. This issue records the requested work; the user's request to create issues is not an implementation or broader test-behavior approval. Follow the existing-test-behavior gate for retiring tests; preserve assertions and map source coverage to its destination.
title: Combine duplicate successful delivery executor tests
